name: ant_bivouac_cutaway
description: The army-ant bivouac cut open: identical outline, anchor and extents to ant_bivouac (top-centre anchor = attachment, x -310..310, y 0..560) with the front cut away to show a warm #8a4a2a cavity walled by layered ant chains, two chain curtains hanging inside, a heap of white larvae left of centre at about (-80,220) and the swollen-gaster queen (cream membrane bands) just right of centre, body centred at about (+40,+330), with a few nurse workers.
